theories.theory: Owners with observable acquisition activity will engage when shown one specific, evidence-backed conversion risk on their public page.
theories.one_change: Lead with one observed page condition and its likely decision consequence, with uncertainty stated.
theories.audience: Owners with a live offer page and observable acquisition activity
theories.falsifier: 20 eligible contacts with independently verified selection evidence and zero qualified replies
theories.window: 20 eligible contacts or 14 days, whichever comes first
theories.next_if_supported: Run viability test for the same diagnosis-to-repair framing.
theories.next_if_falsified: Retire this framing; do not infer the page problem is unimportant without testing another value job.

theories.theory: Owners respond more strongly to the possibility of wasted acquisition spend than to generic conversion language.
theories.one_change: Frame the message around protecting paid clicks, not CRO expertise.
theories.audience: Owners with observable paid acquisition activity and a live offer page
theories.falsifier: 20 eligible contacts with zero qualified replies after delivery is independently verified
theories.window: 20 eligible contacts or 14 days, whichever comes first
theories.next_if_supported: Offer a fixed-scope paid repair after the diagnosis is accepted.
theories.next_if_falsified: Test a non-spend framing with the same observed page condition.

theories.theory: Owners shortly after a launch have enough urgency to evaluate conversion leaks even when they do not yet describe a conversion problem.
selection_evidence: public launch within the defined window
theories.one_change: Frame the audit as launch-readiness and demand capture protection.
theories.audience: Owners with a recent public launch and live offer page
theories.falsifier: 20 eligible launch contacts with zero qualified replies
theories.window: 20 eligible contacts or 14 days, whichever comes first
theories.next_if_supported: Run a paid repair test against the launch cohort.
theories.next_if_falsified: Retire launch timing as a standalone trigger.

theories.theory: Agencies or operators responsible for multiple client pages have a stronger reason to buy a repeatable diagnostic and repair process than individual founders.
theories.one_change: Frame the offer as repeatable evidence and repair capacity, not a founder audit.
theories.audience: Agencies, growth operators, or consultants with repeated page responsibility
theories.falsifier: 20 eligible contacts with zero qualified replies
theories.window: 20 eligible contacts or 14 days, whichever comes first
theories.next_if_supported: Test the $497 agency partner route only after a real purchase signal.
theories.next_if_falsified: Do not broaden agency targeting from this result alone.

rules: A theory remains untested until the defined exposure begins.
Traffic must be intentionally selected by the theory's evidence rule, never by generic reach.
A prospect need not know the diagnostic vocabulary; Nebula must show the evidence clearly.
Replies, clicks, audits, and checkouts are diagnostic signals, not success.
Only a payment joined to the attribution key creates sale_signal.
Do not compare theories with different sample sizes without reporting the imbalance.
Do not promote a theory from one reply or one purchase; manually inspect customer quality, margin, fulfillment, and attribution.
